config.text: {{templates.welcome_msg.text}}

config.prompt: Quick patient check — solve this before we open your file.
This is a CareFlow demonstration. Do not enter real medical history or someone else’s ID.
config.confirmLabel: I understand — continue as a demo patient

config.text:
{{templates.main_menu.text}}

{color:muted}Pick one — we’ll only ask for details after that.{/color}
A couple of details for **{{vars.service}}** — then we continue.

config.prompt: Patient full name as it should appear on the clinic file?
Date of birth? (demo — use any date)
Mobile number for appointment SMS reminders?
Email for prescriptions and visit summaries?
Which CareFlow area is most convenient?
How are you feeling as you start this visit?

assignments.value: ["Our team reviews your request","You receive a confirmation email","A care coordinator may follow up","Keep this reference for your records"]

config.text: Let’s book a clinic or telehealth slot.

config.prompt: Roughly where should we see you? (optional)

config.text:
Booked **{{vars.visit_type}}** for **{{prettify(vars.appointment_at)}}**.
Reminder day: **{{formatDate(dateAdd(vars.appointment_at, -1, "days"), "EEE d MMM")}}**.
Reference: **{{vars.booking_id}}** · returning patient: **{{if(vars.returning_patient, "yes", "no")}}**.
{{if(empty(vars.clinician_pref), "", concat("Preferred rating: ", vars.clinician_pref, "★"))}}
Short triage — not a diagnosis.
{color:danger}**Higher severity**{/color} ({{vars.severity}}/5). A nurse would call you next. There are **{{length(vars.live_services.data)}}** clinic services available right now.
{color:success}**Routine triage**{/color} for **{{vars.main_symptom}}** (~{{vars.symptom_days}} days). There are **{{length(vars.live_services.data)}}** clinic services available right now.
Triage complete for **{{vars.main_symptom}}**.
Add wellness items, then pay the cart total (demo payment).

config.prompt: Browse the CareFlow pharmacy and checkout.

config.text: Cart total **{{vars.cart.total}} {{vars.cart.currency}}** · payment `{{coalesce(vars.payment.reference, "demo")}}`.
Request a copy of your medical records.

config.prompt: Enter the verification code sent to your email (any 6 digits for this demo).

config.text: **{{vars.record_type}}** queued for **{{vars.visitor_name}}**. PDF pack is attached at wrap-up.
Tell us about your last visit.

config.prompt: How likely are you to recommend CareFlow? (0–10)

config.text: {color:success}**Thank you!**{/color} NPS **{{vars.nps}}** · wait **{{vars.wait_stars}}★** · helpful: **{{vars.visit_thumbs}}**.
{color:warning}**We hear you.**{/color} NPS **{{vars.nps}}** · department **{{vars.visit_form.department}}**.
Feedback saved for **{{vars.visit_form.department}}** · score band {{if(vars.nps >= 9, "promoter", if(vars.nps >= 7, "passive", "detractor"))}}.

config.body: {"to":"{{vars.email}}","subject":"CareFlow Clinic: {{vars.service}}","body":"Thanks {{vars.visitor_name}} -- we logged your {{vars.service}} request. Ref {{vars.reference}}."}

config.text: {{vars.check_index + 1}}. {{vars.check_item}}

config.prompt: Please sign so we can stamp your confirmation pack.
